text: The initiative integrates financial regulation with climate hazard preparedness, emphasizing transparency and governance over debt-funded crisis response. It aligns national policy with international climate finance responsibilities, enhancing the potential to mobilize private capital for resilience. The FMA's climate-related disclosures regime serves as a foundational market enabler for risk financing, improving data on drought exposure and vulnerability.

metadata.solution_name: Drought‑focused Government Risk Financing in New Zealand (2020–2025)
